title: Specular differentiation in normed vector spaces
summary: This paper develops specular differentiation for mappings between real normed vector spaces, extending the classical notions of Gâteaux and Fréchet differentiability. These notions apply to a broad class of nonsmooth functions, including functions for which certain other generalized derivatives do not exist. We investigate their fundamental theoretical properties and establish a Quasi-Mean Value Theorem for real-valued functions.
